description: Package must declare name & address of manufacturer, or manufacturer+packer, or importer.
notes: Exempt for food articles (use FSSAI rules instead) and, transitionally 15-Jul-2022 to 15-Jul-2023, satisfiable via QR code for electronic products.

description: For food articles, this declaration is governed by the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 instead of PCR rule 6(1)(a).
Imported products must declare country of origin/manufacture/assembly on the package.
Package must declare the common/generic name of the commodity.
Package must declare net quantity in standard units (weight/measure/number).
notes: Exact rule-8/9 small-package exemption thresholds NOT verified this session - do not auto-fail packages under suspected exemption size until LM-PCR-R8/R9 stubs are resolved.

description: Net quantity unit must be a recognized standard unit (g/kg/ml/l/cm/m/number).
Package must declare month and year of manufacture/pack/import.
notes: Wording tightened by AMD-2021-779; exact current text needs verification (see LM-PCR-R6-1-D provision note). Known exemptions (per project docs, unverified this session): PSU-filled 14.2kg/5kg domestic LPG cylinders; bidi/agarbatti packages.

description: LPG cylinders (PSU-filled, 14.2kg or 5kg domestic) and bidi/agarbatti packages are exempt from the manufacture-date declaration.
notes: Referenced in Stage-1 project notes from an OCR read of SRC-001 p.6; re-verify exact wording before activating.

description: Perishable/time-limited commodities must declare 'best before' or 'use by' date/month/year.
notes: Does not apply if another law already covers it (e.g. FSSAI shelf-life rules for food).

description: Package must declare MRP.
MRP text must clearly state it is the Maximum Retail Price, inclusive of all taxes, in Indian currency (e.g. 'MRP Rs. xx.xx (incl. of all taxes)').
MRP in rupees/paise must be rounded to the nearest rupee or 50 paise.

Alcoholic beverages / spirituous liquor: MRP follows State Excise law (within the manufacturing state), where that law itself provides for a retail-price declaration; otherwise PCR rule 6(1)(e) applies.
Essential commodities with a price fixed/notified by a competent authority under the Essential Commodities Act, 1955 must display that notified price as MRP.

Barcode/GTIN/QR code and authorised Government scheme logos (e.g. Swachh Bharat Mission) MAY optionally be present in addition to mandatory declarations - their presence/absence is not itself a compliance signal.
E-commerce listing must display all rule 6(1) mandatory declarations except manufacture month/year.

In a marketplace model, declaration-correctness liability sits with manufacturer/seller/dealer/importer, not the platform, UNLESS the platform actively participated in the violation or failed to act on actual notice - informational rule for officer review workflow, not an auto PASS/FAIL check on a package.
E-commerce listings of imported products must provide a searchable & sortable country-of-origin filter.
notes: Superseding chain: AMD-2026-128 (eff. 1-Jul-2026) was itself replaced by AMD-2026-312 before its effective date arrived, re-timing this to 1-Jul-2027. Do not activate before that date.

description: Unit sale price must be declared, rounded to 2 decimal places, using the correct basis (per gram/kg, per cm/m, per ml/l, or per number) depending on net quantity magnitude and unit type.
parameters: {"decimal_places": 2, "basis_rules": [{"if_unit": "g", "if_qty_lt": 1000, "declare_as": "per gram"}, {"if_unit": "g", "if_qty_gte": 1000, "declare_as": "per kilogram"}, {"if_unit": "cm", "if_qty_lt": 100, "declare_as": "per centimetre"}, {"if_unit": "cm", "if_qty_gte": 100, "declare_as": "per metre"}, {"if_unit": "ml", "if_qty_lt": 1000, "declare_as": "per millilitre"}, {"if_unit": "ml", "if_qty_gte": 1000, "declare_as": "per litre"}, {"if_unit": "number", "declare_as": "per number"}]}
notes: Alcoholic beverages/spirituous liquor follow State Excise law instead (see LM-CR-007D pattern).

description: Numerals/letters in declarations must meet the minimum height specified in Table-I for the package's Principal Display Panel area.
notes: Table-I numeric thresholds by PDP-area band were visible in OCR but not fully transcribed this session - transcribe from SRC-026 pp.10-11 before activating as a hard FAIL check.

description: For medical-device packages, letter-height standard is instead governed by the Medical Devices Rules, 2017.
Letter/numeral width must be >= 1/3 of its height (except numeral '1' and letters i/I/l).
For medical-device packages, letter-width standard is instead governed by the Medical Devices Rules, 2017.
Packages > 25 kg or > 25 litre are OUT OF SCOPE for Chapter II retail-sale declarations entirely (do not run rule 6/7 checks).
Cement, fertilizer, and agricultural farm produce sold in bags ABOVE 50 kg are OUT OF SCOPE. Farm produce packages of 50 kg or below ARE in scope (confirmed by DCA advisory).
Packaged commodities meant for industrial consumers or institutional consumers are OUT OF SCOPE for Chapter II.
Every individual package inside a promotional group/combo must independently satisfy rule 6 declarations - grouping does not create an exemption.
For items sold by number, use one of: number/unit/piece/pair/set (or equivalent word) to represent package quantity.
Packages of scheduled/non-scheduled formulations under the Drugs (Price Control) Order, 2013 are exempt from PCR declarations, EXCEPT medical devices declared as drugs (no exemption for those).

Loose/open garments & hosiery are exempt from standard packaging declarations ONLY if the product itself bears: manufacturer/brand+COO, consumer-care email+phone, internationally recognizable size (S/M/L/XL/XXL/XXXL) with metric cm/m detail, and MRP incl. all taxes. If sold via e-commerce, the same 4 items must also appear on the online listing.
Pan masala packages CANNOT rely on the general exemption in rule 26(a) - standard declaration rules apply in full.

Importers using AEO Tier-2/Tier-3 bonded warehouses may complete mandatory declarations there, PROVIDED all declarations are complete before the retail packages leave the bonded warehouse - a package leaving the warehouse incomplete is a violation regardless of import-stage timing excuses.
Manufacturer/packer/importer registration record must name the Director responsible for violations under the Act/rules.
notes: This is a registration-record check (officer-dashboard / registry data), not a per-package OCR check.

description: Registered company/firm details must be updated annually via the online portal if any particular has changed.
notes: Registry/administrative check, not a per-package OCR check.

description: Where the Medical Devices Rules, 2017 apply to a package, the general rule-33 relaxation does NOT apply - do not grant any rule-33-based leniency to medical-device packages.
